rules.text: An elemental affinity must alter at least two declared construction dimensions such as material, silhouette, anatomy, motion, equipment, attack telegraph, environmental wake, or exposed counterplay; a palette or glow overlay alone is insufficient.
Normal variants must read as explicitly unaffiliated and must not acquire elemental materials, glow, anatomy, or environmental effects merely to compete with affinity variants.
Every affinity variant must preserve the species or chassis identity, battlefield duty, load-bearing anatomy, and readable counterplay anchors before adding affinity expression.

Monster grade, level, battlefield duty, affinity, and randomized physical attributes remain separate axes; grades seven through ten may escalate scale, musculature, weapons, construction complexity, or magical intensity but may not obscure species identity or affinity readability.

Each pack must declare one coherent style contract; Pack 2 remains medieval, while later packs may use other eras or genres without weakening shared rendering quality, full-body readability, or within-pack cohesion.

Higher power should be communicated through species-appropriate scale, construction, craftsmanship, material behavior, silhouette, weapons, and controlled resonance geometry; glow alone is not a sufficient rarity or power signal.

Human packs must vary body proportions, height, build, face construction, hair, clothing layers, footwear, trousers, torso garments, arm treatments, and headwear through compatibility-aware combinations that preserve role, identity, and plausible equipment contact.

Every rarity and presentation receives premium anatomy, lighting, texture, composition, and identity specificity; exposure, glamour posing, or anatomy exaggeration must not carry rarity, power, or human value.
